beat.title: Celyn and El Discuss Magic
beat.boundaryReason: The four turns form one uninterrupted conversation in Asineau after Robin's speech.
dateEvidence: The session manifest places the exchange on January 12, 1720, using its quoted context from the January 12 Asineau Fallout exchange.
No time-of-day or intervening day transition is established in this email.

sourceLines.text: Four-message email exchange, 16 February–15 March 2024. Each newly authored turn is preserved below in sent order. Repeated quoted-reply history and the mailing-list footer are omitted. The first message quoted a passage from an earlier thread; that context is retained once.

sourceLines.text: Pulling this bit out and starting a separate thread for it.

sourceLines.text: > As Robin's speech winds down, El has walked a bit closer to the manor, and is now standing with a small crowd across the pasture from Robin. They speak, softly at first, so you can't hear, and then, clap their hands and stands up straight, looking clear eyed and straight at Robin, like they are trying to send him a message somehow: "the Wyrdling and the Wanderer both will look after us, as they have before, and will again. Watch for signs, and strive with all your might, and Fate will provide." They nod, and turn back towards the temple, but stops when Celyn starts talking to the horse and stares at him intently. > > [Meta: Kiya, we can go back in time and run this interaction later, I assume you might not see this until the story has moved on ]

sourceLines.text: Celyn finishes up talking to the horses and sets the whole sideplot of finding the girl in motion, then peers curiously back at El. He’s not bothered by being stared at, just sort of curious about it, with that wide-eyed mooncalf manner of his.

sourceLines.text: [meta: I'm going to presume you had the conversation about your pasts a bit before this conversation; you had several opportunities to have a long talk with El after their divination at the council meeting]
sourceLines.raw: [u0009 | source] [meta: I'm going to presume you had the conversation about your pasts a bit before this conversation; you had several opportunities to have a long talk with El after their divination at the council meeting]

sourceLines.text: When Celyn stops and looks back at El, he sees his own curiosity reflected in El's eyes. The stare seems to him more one of fascination, an observation of magic being done.
sourceLines.raw: [u0010 | source] When Celyn stops and looks back at El, he sees his own curiosity reflected in El's eyes. The stare seems to him more one of fascination, an observation of magic being done.

sourceLines.text: El looks at you: "So controlled. My miracles shake with chaos..." They turn to go, with a somewhat unreadable look on their face.
sourceLines.raw: [u0011 | source] El looks at you: "So controlled. My miracles shake with chaos..." They turn to go, with a somewhat unreadable look on their face.

sourceLines.text: “The miracle there is of the past, not today.” Celyn will explain more if they ask, but wishes to be clear that this magic is, at least at some level, Different.
sourceLines.raw: [u0016 | source] “The miracle there is of the past, not today.” Celyn will explain more if they ask, but wishes to be clear that this magic is, at least at some level, Different.

sourceLines.text: El merely looks intently at you at this, and gently points towards Viepuck who is starting to talk to the young girl, and when Celyn looks back they have retreated to the temple.
